issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavior change for existing callers.
issues.detail: Callers using the default InputParams() will silently switch endpointing modes, altering VAD emission and finalization behavior. The changelog files this as a 'fix' but it is a breaking default change. Either restore EXTERNAL as default, label it as a breaking change in the changelog, or emit a transitional warning when the default is taken.

issues.description: process_frame narrows accepted stop-speaking frame type, breaking the supertype contract.
issues.detail: Finalization now triggers only on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, not UserStoppedSpeakingFrame. Non-VAD producers of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame silently lose finalization. Either accept both frame types, or document the stricter precondition and subscribe to the VAD frame only when internal VAD is disabled to drop the unreachable warn branch.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED membership and import provenance needs verification and better data shape.
issues.detail: _enable_vad checks EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED but the diff shows no new import; if SDK 0.0.99 lacks it this raises AttributeError at construction. Additionally, the list literal used for the membership test should be a tuple or module-level frozenset to communicate immutability and match a fixed sentinel set.

issues.description: Patch bundles three independent changes and should be split for bisectability.
issues.detail: The diff combines (1) the UserStoppedSpeakingFrame to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame switch, (2) the FIXED turn mode plus default flip, and (3) the new split_sentences/SpeechSegmentConfig wiring. Each is independently reviewable and revertable; bundling them makes future regression bisection painful.

issues.description: split_sentences is plumbed as Optional[bool] then coerced with `or False`, wrong data shape.
issues.detail: Declaring `split_sentences: bool | None = None` and then writing `params.split_sentences or False` adds a tri-state that buys nothing. Make it `bool = False` and pass through, or use `bool(params.split_sentences)`. Also avoid unconditionally overwriting speech_segment_config; only set it when the user opted in to preserve the vendor default.

issues.description: Relocated commented-out `start_processing_metrics` line and stale docstring contradictions.
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was moved rather than deleted or uncommented; dead code should not migrate. Separately, the turn_detection_mode docstring still implies EXTERNAL is Pipecat-controlled while saying FIXED is the default, leaving the FIXED vs EXTERNAL contract undefined. Delete the dead comment and write one-paragraph contracts for each mode.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches consensus that this is a needs-work patch. Two issues dominate: the silent default flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED (a breaking change mislabeled as a fix) and the narrowed stop-speaking frame contract that drops non-VAD finalization. The diff also bundles three logically independent changes that should be split for bisectability, and references EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED without visible import evidence. Smaller cleanups include the Optional[bool] tri-state for split_sentences, an unconditional speech_segment_config overwrite, a relocated dead-code comment, and docstring contradictions about what FIXED versus EXTERNAL now mean.
